transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for joining. I wanted to get us together to discuss the upcoming Northstar and Mosaic forums. As we all know, both groups have their next two monthly forums scheduled for the same week, and attendance has been declining at both forums since the groups began sharing several company-wide initiatives. I'd like to explore whether a combined forum makes sense, and if so, work out the temporary operating rules. Before I approve anything, though, I want to make sure we follow my standard practice: a roundtable with the group chairs, HR, and the executive sponsor to discuss and align on any new operating rules. So let's hear from everyone — what are your thoughts on combining the forums?
